title: Build the book evidence registry and validators
acceptance_criteria: claims.json validates against a committed schema
Every initial claim records strength, scope, limits, run, digest, tag, environment, topology, report, and analysis where applicable
Numeric claims cannot cite failed or invalid cells as winners
Superseded analyses and stale digests are detected
Cross-study numeric comparisons require an explicit comparability record
Scenario transfers are labelled direct evidence or analogy
No new interpretation is introduced by the extractor
validation: negative fixtures for failed cells, stale analyses, missing topology and unsupported ratios
review_policy: HIGH required before claims become book inputs
